pages.title: Where the Trail Begins
pages.text: The material trail begins with mined Draconium; process its dust or ore into ingots according to the active recipes. Draconium Cores, Energy Cores, and then Wyvern Cores form the early chain.$(br2)When an older account disagrees, the current recipes and machine interfaces are the safer record.

pages.title: Where Fusion Leads
pages.text: Fusion opened the path to Awakened Draconium and the parts needed for Draconic equipment. Chaotic work lies at the far end and demands Chaos materials.$(br2)One costly lesson: an injector tier named by a recipe is a hard requirement, not a suggestion about speed.

pages.title: Fusion Components
pages.text: Awakened and Chaotic Cores are Fusion products. Each belongs to its matching material tier and requires injectors of the tier specified by its recipe.$(br2)An item portrait replaces the empty recipe frame because the ordinary frame cannot portray Fusion.
